Achieve a clear, radiant complexion with a clear, natural glow. 

Medicube PDRN Pink Cica Soothing Toner is a glow boosting toner featuring salmon PDRN to help improve skin texture, while enhancing a natural glow. PDRN supports skin vitality and helps improve overall skin condition to give your skin a clearer, more radiant appearance. It also soothes and reinforces the skin barrier to prevent moisture loss while gently wiping away dead skin cells. 

PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide) consists of DNA fragments that help restore the skin's natural barrier function. Mainly extracted from salmon, these DNA fragments are isolated through a process that ensures their high compatibility with human skin cells due to their structural similarity to human DNA. This compatibility enhances the skin’s natural barrier, making it stronger and more resilient.

Salmon PDRN is traditionally used for DNA and skin repair due to it's similarity to human skin tissue. It is highly effective at reducing and suppressing melanin synthesis and filling it with collagen instead.

title: IPSA The Time Reset Aqua (200ml)
body_html:
Kiyoko's Notes

Cosme Award winning toner in 2019 and 2020

The Time Reset Aqua is a long time IPSA best seller and contains their original ingredient: Aqua Presenter III.  Aqua presenter III uses three moisturizing effects to ensure long-lasting hydration and aids the absorption of other skincare products. First, its 1,000 trillion fine moisturizing molecules penetrate deep into the skin. Second, it triggers the skin's natural hydration production. Third, it creates a barrier to seal in moisture.

This lotion forms a moisture veil on the skin to condition it with a refreshing sensation. With a formula combining hydrating ingredients like acetylate hyaluronic acid, which improves moisture delivery to the skin's outer layer, this lotion keeps your skin hydrated all day. It conditions the moisture balance of both dry and oily skin, leaving you with fresh, smooth skin.

Features Deeply hydrates and improves skin's barrier 
Enhances absorption of other skincare products
Long-lasting and refreshing hydration 
Skin Types All skin types. Suitable for sensitive skin.
Made In Japan

  • After cleaning and toning, apply a small amount to the face. Can also be applied using a cotton pad to decrease the potential chilly feeling of the lotion.
  • Apply evenly to the face, then gently pat into the skin until it is fully absorbed.
  • Use greater amounts around visible pores and areas of higher sebum production, such as a T-zone.

  • Peony & Marjoram Extracts: Effective at fighting acne and inflammation, and controlling oil production

Ingredients

Key Ingredients
PHA (Gluconolactone): a polyhydroxy acid (PHA) that acts as a gentle exfoliant, helping to remove dead skin cells and improve skin texture. Madecassoside: derived from Centella asiatica and is known for its soothing properties. It can help calm irritated skin and support skin barrier function.
Hyaluronic Acid: a humectant that attracts and retains moisture in the skin, helping to keep it hydrated and plump.
Centella Asiatica Extract: rich in antioxidants and has soothing properties.

title: Medicube PDRN Pink Peptide Toner (250ml)
body_html:
Kiyoko's Notes

Achieve a clear, radiant complexion with a clear, natural glow. 

Medicube PDRN Pink Peptide Toner is a glow boosting toner featuring Rose PDRN to help improve skin texture, while enhancing a natural glow. Rose PDRN supports skin vitality and helps improve overall skin condition to give your skin a clearer, more radiant appearance. It also soothes and reinforces the skin barrier to prevent moisture loss while gently wiping away dead skin cells. 

PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide) consists of DNA fragments that help restore the skin's natural barrier function. Mainly extracted from salmon, these DNA fragments are isolated through a process that ensures their high compatibility with human skin cells due to their structural similarity to human DNA. title: ILSO Clean Mud Cream (100g)
body_html:
Kiyoko's Notes

is a gentle yet powerful mud mask that thoroughly removes skin impurities and dead skin cells clogged inside pores while keeping skin clean and plump. Formulated with Amazon White Clay + 250,000ppm of Kaolin to gently remove excess sebum, dead skin cells and dirt from skin and clear clogged pores. How to use

Step 1: Prepare your skin

  • Wash your face with a gentle cleanser and pat it dry.
  • For optimal results, steam your face for 30 seconds with a warm towel or shower steam. This opens your pores and allows the mud to penetrate deeper.

Step 2: Apply the magic

  • Apply a thin, even layer of ILSO Clean Mud Cream to your entire face, avoiding the delicate eye and mouth areas.
  • Adjust the application time based on your skin type:
    • 7-10 minutes: Recommended for sensitive or dry skin.
    • 12-15 minutes: Ideal for combination or oily skin.

Step 3: Rinse and reveal

  • Thoroughly rinse the mud off your face with warm water, gently rolling it in circular motions.
  • For an extra boost, mix ILSO Clean Mud Cream with your regular cleanser in a 1:1 ratio. This provides a deeper clean and helps refine your skin texture.

Frequency:

  • Use 2-3 times per week for optimal results
  • For sensitive or dry skin, use 1 time per week

SK-II's trademark product and global favorite, is their facial treatment facial essence made from Pitera. title: AXIS-Y Artichoke Intensive Skin Barrier Ampoule (30ml)
body_html:
Kiyoko's Notes

A specially formulated ampoule featuring antioxidants and anti-inflammatory properties.

AXIS-Y Artichoke Intensive Skin Barrier Ampoule features the core ingredient of artichoke. It is specially formulated to repair and strengthen the skin's natural barrier and prevent skin irritation (it even has a low irritant certification!). The new and improved formula features 2x the Hawkweed extract, which translates to more antioxidants and anti-inflammatory properties. Other base ingredients include Centella Asiatica (soothing), kelp (hydrating), aloe vera (soothing and anti-inflammatory), and okra (hydrating and supports development of healthy skin cells). Your complexion will be brighter, smoother, and visibly healthier!

This product is part of AXIS-Y's 611 line, in which each product is carefully formulated with a combination of 6 nutrient-rich base ingredients, 1 core goal-oriented ingredient, and 1 quality-producing effective technology.

Features

Hydrating ampoule
Will not irritate even sensitive skin types
Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory
No sticky feeling

Dehydrated Skin

An award winning bestseller in Japan, the Curél Intensive Moisture Care Moisturizer Cream is designed specifically for sensitive skin, this moisturizer intensely nourishes and comforts your skin.

Curél Intensive Moisture Facial Cream helps to fill up the ceramide reservoir, and to improve your skin's natural barrier function. 

Features
 Helps protect skin from dryness and external stimuli
Light-as-air texture deeply hydrates
pH balanced, fragrance free, colorant free, alcohol free
Skin Concerns Dryness
Skin Types Dry to Combination
Sensitive
Awards Cosme Award Winner
Made In JAPAN 🇯🇵


How to use

Apply a grape size amount of Curél Intensive Moisture Facial Cream to cheeks, forehead, nose and chin. Smooth cream over your face, working from the inside to the outside in long strokes. 

What is Double Moisturizing?

Millions of Japanese women use a pre-moisturizing liquid (called Emulsion in Japan) as a first step before applying their cream moisturizer — it instantly hydrates to calm dry, sensitive skin, relieves tightness and prepares the skin to absorb and retain moisture. This 2-step routine helps to repair the skin‘s natural protective barrier by locking in essential hydration.

Curél Moisture Facial Lotion is applied to cleansed, dry skin and then followed by Curél Moisture Facial Milk or Curél Intensive Moisture Facial Cream for very dry, sensitive skin.

title: Curél Intensive Moisture Care Foaming Wash (150ml)
body_html:
Kiyoko's Notes

Ultra-soft water-based foam cleanser specially designed for dry and sensitive skin types. 

Designed specifically for dry, sensitive skin, the Curél Foaming Facial Wash thoroughly cleanses impurities ever-so-gently, leaving skin soft and supple while protecting the natural ceramides from being washed off the skin.

The soft foaming facial wash is the second step of the Japanese ritual called Double Cleansing and ideally it is used in combination with Curél Makeup Cleansing Gel. 

Features
 Thoroughly cleanses without stripping hydration
Protects ceramide levels
pH balanced, fragrance free, colorant free
Skin Concerns Clogged pores
Rough skin
Acne

 
Skin Type Dry to Combination Skin
Sensitive Skin
Made In Japan


How to use

  1. Dispense 2 pumps of Curél Foaming Facial Wash into your palm. Apply the foam onto wet skin.
  2. Gently pat dry.
  3. When you don‘t need to remove any makeup (i.e. in the morning), use the Foaming Facial Wash on its own.

What is Double Cleansing?

It is particularly important for dry, sensitive skin to clean thoroughly and yet gently. Curél cleansers have been developed to do just that – cleanse while preserving the skin´s ceramides and therefore the skin's protective barrier. Clean skin will allow moisturizers to work more efficiently.

Double cleansing is a Japanese two-step cleansing method using two different types of cleansers, one after the other.

The first oil-based cleanser (Curél Makeup Cleansing Gel) dissolves makeup and sebum, while the second water-based cleanser (Curél Foaming Facial Wash) washes away anything that’s left over.
